inputs.text: Abinader’s government has signed an agreement in Paris with OECD chief Mathias Cormann to design the Dominican Republic’s first National Integrity and Anti-Corruption Strategy. Fighting corruption matters, but handing the shaping of national policy to unelected international bureaucrats is no substitute for holding our own leaders accountable. These standards must answer to the Dominican people, protect the country’s sovereignty, and strengthen its own institutions—not impose a distant agenda under the banner of “global standards.”
